name: oleuropein
summary: Major secoiridoid from olive leaves and unripe olive oil with NF-κB suppression, AMPK activation, and antihypertensive activity. Multiple human trials support cardiovascular and metabolic benefits.
description: Oleuropein from olive is associated with NF-κB suppression and AMPK-related metabolic signaling in experimental models, suggesting anti-inflammatory and metabolic modulation.
safetyNotes: Generally food-associated via olive/olive leaf, but concentrated extracts may lower blood pressure or glucose. Monitor with antihypertensive or antidiabetic therapy.
